title: A default value
prompt: The robot shows a score, sometimes with a bonus and sometimes without, through one `show_score` helper whose bonus is 0 unless given. report_scores(5) prints 5, then 15 with a bonus of 10.
hints: show_score takes a score and a bonus, the bonus with a default of 0 written after an = sign in the definition, and prints their sum; report_scores calls it once with just the score and once with the score and 10.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
